localShadow.transport: real-fireemu-artifact only; fixture responses are rejected
localShadow.cleanup: fireemu exec owns the daemon and all owned resources

cases.meaning: Linking a provider or password credential to an existing email has the documented collision result and leaves the account unchanged on refusal.
cases.operation: client SDK linkWithCredential plus Admin lookup control
cases.negative: duplicate email collision and wrong-principal lookup
cases.ownedResources: two generated local accounts; no production account
cases.cleanup: delete both owned UIDs and verify lookup absence

cases.meaning: Client SDK policy/config reads use the client route and do not gain Admin project-config privileges; email privacy changes affect only the documented client behavior.
cases.operation: client Auth config/policy read plus Admin readback control
cases.control: owner/Admin update and client observation on the same local project
cases.ownedResources: none; configuration snapshot required before any local mutation
cases.cleanup: restore local configuration digest and verify readback

cases.meaning: Blocking selection and token/claim forwarding are tied to the authenticated project/tenant and cannot be selected by a caller-supplied localId.
cases.operation: client signup/signin through blocking fixture and token readback
cases.negative: unauthenticated localId selection and wrong tenant
cases.control: owner-bound project/tenant flow with explicit claim
cases.cleanup: delete all generated accounts and verify no token remains usable

cases.meaning: Signup quota simulation reports the bounded response without turning fixture acceptance into a service quota claim.
cases.operation: finite local signup sequence with explicit quota profile
cases.negative: quota rejection does not create an account or issue a token
cases.cleanup: recover every UID, including after uncertain responses

campaignEnvelope.manifestDigest: computed after owner inputs and collector freeze
campaignEnvelope.postFixConfirmation: at most one per approved case; saved reference preferred
campaignEnvelope.configurationChanges: none in local shadow; production email privacy/blocking changes require exclusive CONFIG_MUTATING approval
